context: Herald Square: two hot-dog carts nose to nose on one corner.

lines.speaker: npc.cart_vendor
lines.text: My permit says this corner! Thirty years this corner!

lines.speaker: npc.cart_vendor
lines.text: Your permit says Thirty-Fifth! Learn to read, Dominick!

choices.text: Check the permit at the licence office.
Seniority wins. Thirty years is thirty.

lines.speaker: npc.cart_vendor
lines.text: Fine. The clerk. He's a crook, but he's our crook.

lines.speaker: npc.cart_vendor
lines.text: Thirty years! You hear that? Respect!

lines.speaker: npc.cart_vendor
lines.text: Five bucks. You're worse than the cops.

lines.speaker: npc.cart_vendor
lines.text: Business is like the weather. Terrible, and here we are.
